chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ibn Bukayr, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When a man dies and leaves his father, and he is a slave, or his mother, and she is a slave, and the deceased is a free man, his father or his relatives are purchased from what he left, and they inherit the remainder of the wealth.
ai.seo_question: How is the inheritance of a slave parent calculated when the deceased is a free man?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'itq' (manumission) funded by the estate, ensuring that a slave parent of a free deceased is elevated to freedom before inheritance distribution. This mechanism highlights the Shia juristic view that manumission is a debt of the estate, prioritizing the parent's status change to allow them to inherit as free heirs, distinct from the general rule where slaves do not inherit from free relatives.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Ibn Bukeyr, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the man dies and leaves his father and he is a slave, or his mother and she is a slave, and the deceased is a free man, his father or his relatives be bought from what is left (the legacy), and they would inherit the remainder of the wealth’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from ibn Bukayr from certain persons of our people who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When a man dies leaving behind his father who is owned by someone or his mother who is owned by someone and the deceased is free, with his legacy, his father or relative is bought who then is made to inherit the remaining of the legacy.’”
